features.title: Multilingual Search
features.description: Search across thousands of languages at once. Type in any language and find definitions, translations, and usage examples instantly.

features.title: Cultural Context
features.description: Every word comes with cultural notes, usage patterns, and regional variations so you understand meaning beyond the literal translation.

features.title: Pronunciation Guides
features.description: Listen to native speaker pronunciations and phonetic breakdowns for accurate learning and communication.

features.title: Language Preservation
features.description: We actively document endangered languages in partnership with communities to ensure no language is lost to time.

features.title: Community Driven
features.description: Our entries are enriched by native speakers and linguists, ensuring authenticity and depth in every definition.

features.title: Offline Access
features.description: Download language packs for offline use. Access definitions, pronunciations, and examples without an internet connection.
